noPhone.title: No phone number needed
noPhone.body: You don't need a phone number or email. Just pick a name. gim gives you an Account ID.

onYourDevices.title: Your account lives on your devices
onYourDevices.body: Your account is kept on your devices, not on a server. Want to use it somewhere else? Link another device.

lockedMessages.title: Your messages are locked
lockedMessages.body: Messages are end-to-end encrypted. Only the people in the chat can read them. Not even the server can.

welcome.explanation: Chat with the people you care about. Start a new account, or use the one you already have.
welcome.link: Link to a device you already use

server.title: Choose your server
server.label: Server address
server.invalid: Enter a full address, like https://example.com
server.unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check the address and your internet connection.

link.qrExplanation: On a device where you use gim, open Settings > Account and devices, choose “Link a new device” and scan this code.
link.sasExplanation: Your other device shows a code too. Choose “The codes match” only if both are the same.
link.linked: This device is linked. Your chats appear after the first sync.
link.timedOut: No device answered in time. Show a new code to try again.
link.failed: Linking didn't work. Show a new code to try again.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.retryLater: The server is busy. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

create.nameExplanation: People see this name in your chats. You can change it later.
create.nameInvalid: Your name can be 1–64 characters long.
create.notAdmitted: This server doesn't accept new accounts from you.

kit.title: Your recovery kit
kit.explanation: This is a spare key to your account. If you lose all your devices, your Account ID and recovery key get your account back. Keep them secret. You see them only now, so save them somewhere safe.
kit.saveFailed: Couldn't save the file. Copy the kit instead.
kit.checkExplanation: Type the last 4 characters of your recovery key. This makes sure you saved it.
kit.checkMismatch: That doesn't match. Look at your recovery key and try again.

file.title: gim recovery kit
file.note: Keep this secret. Anyone who has it can get into your account. Lost all your devices? Open gim, choose “Restore with your recovery kit” and paste this text.

restore.title: Restore your account
restore.explanation: Use the recovery kit you saved when you made your account. Old chats don't come back. Friends need to add you to groups again.
restore.kitHelper: Paste all of it. We find your Account ID and recovery key in it.
restore.kitFound: Account ID and recovery key found.
restore.kitNotRecognized: We couldn't find an Account ID or recovery key here. Paste the whole kit, or type them below.
restore.kitIncomplete: Part of the kit is missing. Fill in the empty field below.
restore.userIdHelper: Starts with “u”. It's in your recovery kit.
restore.recoveryCodeHelper: 39 characters. Dashes and spaces are fine.
restore.revokeOthersHelper: They get signed out. Do this if a device was lost or stolen.
restore.invalidUserId: This isn't an Account ID. It starts with “u” and has 56 characters.
restore.invalidRecoveryCode: This isn't a recovery key. Check each character.
restore.wrongRecoveryCode: This recovery key doesn't fit this account. Check the key and the Account ID.
restore.unknownUser: This server has no account with this Account ID. Check the ID and the server.
